mapper.select: SELECT c.ch_num AS chNum, c.ch_level AS chLevel, c.ch_exp AS chExp, c.user_num AS userNum, c.cg_num AS cgNum, cg.cg_name AS cgName, cg.cg_img AS cgImg, (SELECT COALESCE(MAX(he_exp), 0) FROM highest_exp WHERE he_level < c.ch_level) AS currentLevelExp, (SELECT COALESCE(MIN(he_exp), 60000) FROM highest_exp WHERE he_level > c.ch_level) AS nextLevelExp FROM `character` c JOIN character_grow cg ON c.cg_num = cg.cg_num WHERE c.user_num = #{userNum}
SELECT he_exp FROM highest_exp WHERE he_level > #{currentLevel} ORDER BY he_level ASC LIMIT 1
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO exp_history ( eh_exp, eh_type_name, ch_num, ed_num, eh_current_lv, eh_is_level_up, eh_created_at ) SELECT #{exp}, #{source}, c.ch_num, (SELECT ed_num FROM exp_details WHERE ed_type = #{source} LIMIT 1), c.ch_level, #{isLevelUp}, NOW() FROM `character` c WHERE c.user_num = #{userNum}
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM exp_history eh WHERE eh.ch_num = (SELECT ch_num FROM `character` WHERE user_num = #{userNum} LIMIT 1) AND eh.eh_type_name = #{source} AND DATE(eh.eh_created_at) = CURRENT_DATE()
